headline_marked: [[BNP leader critically injured]] in drive-by shooting in Dhaka's Pallabi
headline: BNP leader critically injured in drive-by shooting in Dhaka's Pallabi
summary: Assailants fired three rounds from a moving car, injuring a local BNP leader and a female passerby in Mirpur-11.
details: A local BNP leader and a female passerby were shot after assailants opened fire from a moving car in Dhaka's Pallabi area this evening.
The injured leader, 45-year-old Alamgir Hossain, a fish trader and member of the BNP's Nawabganj upazila unit, is in critical condition with bullet injuries to his head, abdomen, and hip.

The second victim, 50-year-old Josna, suffered a bullet injury to her leg. Both victims were rushed to hospitals, with Alamgir admitted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital (DMCH) and Josna to Kurmitola General Hospital.
According to DC Mostak Sarkar of the DMP's Mirpur Division, the shooting occurred around 5:45 pm in Lane 2 of Millat Camp in Mirpur-11.
Police have identified the alleged shooters as Rubel, alias 'Langra Rubel', and his associate Pappa, both of whom are known drug peddlers. Drives to arrest them are currently underway.
The victim's family suspects the attack may have been linked to political rivalry, while police continue their investigation into the incident.

headline_marked: Medical student [[detained with toy pistol]] during minister's visit to Natore
headline: Medical student detained with toy pistol during minister's visit to Natore
summary: A 29-year-old man was held by police after being found with a dummy weapon at a public event attended by Civil Aviation Minister Afroza Khanam.
details: A young man was detained on Friday afternoon in the Dighapatia area of Natore during a visit by Civil Aviation and Tourism Minister Afroza Khanam.
The detainee, identified as 29-year-old Md Al Amin, is reportedly a student at a private medical college.
According to Sub-inspector Md Shahadat Hossain of Natore Sadar Police Station, Al Amin was detained on suspicion at the Uttara Ganabhaban area upon his arrival at the event.
Upon searching the man, law enforcement officers recovered a pistol-like object, which police later identified as a toy pistol.
The detainee claimed he was carrying the dummy weapon for his own safety.
Police stated that further action will be taken against him following consultations with senior officials.
